# Deprecated Monta API operations

Operations the Monta API spec marks as deprecated. Do not use them for new work. The note quotes the spec, which names the replacement when there is one.

## v1

| Operation ID | Method and path | Deprecation note | Docs |
|---|---|---|---|
| get-afir-charge-points | GET /api/v1/afir/charge-points | **Deprecated.** Use the DATEX II-compliant AFIR charge points endpoint in the Monta Public API instead: [List AFIR-compliant charge points](https://docs.public-api.monta.com/reference/get-afir-charge-points). | [docs](https://developer.monta.com/api/v1/retrieve-a-list-of-afir-charge-points) |
| get-auth-information | GET /api/v1/auth/me | Deprecated, will be removed by 01.04.24, use `/api/v1/consumers/me` instead. | [docs](https://developer.monta.com/api/v1/obtain-information-about-current-api-consumer) |
| get-charges-insights | GET /api/v1/charges/insights | **Deprecated, use `/insights/charges/driver-report` and `/insights/charges/charger-report` instead.** | [docs](https://developer.monta.com/api/v1/retrieve-insights-about-charges) |
| resolve-report | POST /api/v1/reports/{reportId}/resolve | For operational/system alerts use `/alerts` and `/issues`; `source=system` reports will stop being produced when the legacy alerting is switched off.<br/><br/>Required scope: `reports:write` | [docs](https://developer.monta.com/api/v1/resolve-a-report-related-to-a-charge-point) |
| patch-transaction | PATCH /api/v1/wallet-transactions/{transactionId} | **Note: This has been deprecated and won't do anything.** Required scope: `transaction:write` | [docs](https://developer.monta.com/api/v1/patch-an-existing-transaction) |
